title: Modernize public theme with semantic Tailwind tokens and accessible typography/contrast

requirements.summary: Modernize global design tokens and typography using semantic Tailwind token colors (no hard-coded one-off colors) for a professional public-site look consistent with admin styling foundations.
acceptanceCriteria: Global styles are updated in frontend/src/index.css (and related Tailwind token usage) so primary UI surfaces use semantic tokens (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-card, text-muted-foreground, border-border, etc.).
Typography is standardized (body, headings, labels) with consistent font-family usage and a modern, professional scale across the public pages.
No public-facing components rely on hard-coded colors that reduce legibility (e.g., fixed chrome text on similarly bright backgrounds).

file_operations.description: Adjust Tailwind theme extensions to better support a modern typographic system (font families for sans/serif/mono) and ensure semantic tokens (background/foreground/card/muted/accent/border/ring) are the preferred primitives for public UI styling. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update global CSS variables (light/dark) to provide consistent semantic token mapping (background/foreground/card/muted/accent/border/input/ring) and add standardized base typography (body + heading scale, label defaults) using the existing fonts; ensure globals avoid hard-coded foreground/background pairings that can reduce legibility. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Ensure readable contrast and accessible interactive/focus states across light/dark mode by auditing key UI compositions (buttons, inputs, cards, nav/header, menus/tabs) and adjusting foreground/background pairings to semantic defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary text, muted text, borders, and interactive states remain clearly legible in light mode and dark mode.
Interactive states (hover/focus/active/disabled) remain readable and clearly distinguishable.
Focus indicators remain visible on all backgrounds (keyboard navigation).

file_operations.description: Revise global focus-visible styling to use semantic ring tokens (ring, ring-offset-background) rather than fixed colors, and ensure base element defaults (links/buttons/inputs) maintain readable contrast in both themes without relying on hard-coded outline colors. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Replace any hard-coded loading text colors with semantic token classes (e.g., text-muted-foreground / text-foreground) and ensure loading/fallback UI remains readable in both light and dark mode. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Audit and update navigation/menu button styling to ensure readable contrast for default/active/hover/focus states using semantic tokens (background/foreground/muted/accent/border/ring), avoiding fixed chrome color classes that can reduce legibility across themes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Modernize public-facing layout styling (header, footer, landing hero/sections) for a cohesive professional feel while keeping existing navigation and content unchanged.
acceptanceCriteria: Brand header (frontend/src/components/BrandHeader.tsx), shell/footer (frontend/src/components/AppShell.tsx), and landing page (frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx) have a cohesive modern/professional visual treatment (spacing, borders, surfaces, typography).
No routes, copy, or core behaviors change—this is a styling/theme modernization only.
The landing page remains responsive and visually consistent from mobile to desktop.

file_operations.description: Update shell/footer surface styling to match the admin panel’s polished feel using semantic tokens (bg-background/bg-card, text-foreground/text-muted-foreground, border-border) and refined spacing; keep structure, navigation, and copy unchanged. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Modernize header layout styling (sticky header surface, borders, active nav styling, mobile sheet trigger styling) using semantic tokens instead of chrome-specific classes; preserve current nav items and behavior. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Refresh landing hero/sections styling to be more modern/professional (typography scale alignment, card surfaces, gradients/overlays, spacing) while keeping existing content and navigation actions intact; replace hard-coded chrome color usage with semantic token usage where possible. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Validate and align readability/contrast across all existing admin themes (goth-black, silver-steel, white-luxury, deep-purple, fire-red) by ensuring admin UI compositions consistently use semantic token variables and predictable theme-scoped values.
acceptanceCriteria: Switching between all existing admin themes does not produce low-contrast text (e.g., labels, inputs, table text) or invisible borders.
Admin UI elements used throughout the admin panel keep consistent semantic token usage for backgrounds/foregrounds/borders so theme swaps remain predictable.

file_operations.description: Define/adjust admin theme class variable sets (e.g., .admin-theme-goth-black, .admin-theme-silver-steel, .admin-theme-white-luxury, .admin-theme-deep-purple, .admin-theme-fire-red) so each theme establishes readable semantic tokens (background/foreground/card/muted/border/input/ring) and consistent admin accent variables used by the admin panel; ensure theme switching does not create low contrast. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the admin theme wrapper applies appropriate semantic surface/text classes (bg-background text-foreground) in addition to theme class names so admin pages inherit readable defaults across all themes. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Update the theme switcher styling to use semantic token classes for trigger/content text, borders, and focus rings so it remains readable across all admin themes without relying on fixed cyber colors. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Audit and adjust admin panel compositions that currently rely on fixed color utilities (borders/text/backgrounds for cards, tabs, inputs, badges, status highlights) to ensure they use predictable semantic tokens and remain readable across all existing admin themes (without changing routes or behaviors). Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.
